title: Background effect and style to match other widgets
line: Sticky Notes have a new "Plasma Style" color option that gives them the same background as other desktop widgets.
explanation: Wish: the Sticky Note widget always set NoBackground and drew one of its own notes.svg papers (eight colors or transparent), so it could never look like the other widgets with the theme's frosted widget background. The change adds a "Plasma Style" entry (config value "theme") to the right-click color menu and to the Appearance page: with it the applet asks for DefaultBackground, drops its paper and margins and uses the theme text color, as it already did for Transparent in a panel. The settings thumbnail draws widgets/background and the menu uses the preferences-desktop-plasma-theme icon.

commits.message:
applets/notes: add a Plasma Style background option

Sticky notes could only use their own colored papers or a fully
transparent background, so they never matched the other widgets. Add a
"Plasma Style" choice that uses the standard widget background instead.

BUG: 526480

media.caption: Master: a yellow note and a Transparent note next to a Calendar widget; neither note matches the Calendar's widget background
With the change: the second note set to Plasma Style has the same background as the Calendar
Master: Sticky Note Settings > Appearance offers only the note papers and the two transparent variants
With the change: a new "Plasma Style background" choice at the end of the list
